Ugandan traffic law gives riders duties: Ebiragiro by'omu muhanda omu Uganda nibiha abavugi emirimo n'oburinzi. Buri nshonga ahansi neeyoreka Act nari ekiragiro ahu erugire.
Carry your licence and registration docu: Twara laisensi yaawe n'ebihandiiko by'okuhandiikisa pikipiki
Section 146(1) of the Traffic and Road S: Section 146(1) ya Traffic and Road Safety Act, nk'oku yahindurirwe omu 2020, negamba ngu omuntu orikuvuga omu muhanda aine kutwara kopi ya laisensi y'okuvuga ehikire obwire bwona, kandi akaayoreka ey'enyini omu shaaha 72 omupolisi ajwaire yunifomu yaamushaba. Section 146(2) negamba nikyo kimwe aha kopi y'ekitabo ky'okuhandiikisa (logbook), ey'enyini ekorekwa omu shaaha 120.
You do not have to carry the original li: Toine kutwara laisensi ey'enyini buri izooba, kwonka oine kutwara kopi. Omupolisi yaakushaba, oreke laisensi ey'enyini omu biro 3 (eshaaha 72) n'ekitabo ky'okuhandiikisa eky'enyini omu biro 5 (eshaaha 120).
Keep a clear copy or photo of your licen: Biika gye kopi erikureebeka gye nari ekishushani kya laisensi yaawe n'ekitabo ky'okuhandiikisa pikipiki.
If asked for the original, take it to th: Bakushaba ey'enyini, ogitwaare aha sitesheni ya poliisi omu bwire obu ekiragiro kirikwikiriza.
Write down the officer’s name, station,: Handiika eiziina ry'omupolisi, sitesheni ye, na section y'ekiragiro eri aha baruha yoona ei orikuhabwa.
Your licence must match the motorcycle y: Laisensi yaawe eine kuhikaana na pikipiki ei orikuvuga
Section 35(1) of the Traffic and Road Sa: Section 35(1) ya Traffic and Road Safety Act neetaka ngu omuntu abe aine laisensi ehikire y'ekika ky'ekimotoka eki arikuvuga. Section 36 neeyoreka ebika bya laisensi, kandi sections 70(1)(g) na 94(1)(g) nizigamba aha laisensi za pikipiki na pikipiki z'emipiira eshatu ezirikukozesibwa kushaaha sente, harimu Class M.
A licence for one group of vehicles does: Laisensi y'ekika kimwe ky'ebimotoka terikwikiriza ekindi kika. Waaba notwara abantu ahabwa sente, reeba ngu ekika ekiri aha laisensi yaawe nikikwikiriza omurimo ogwo.
Reeba ekika ekiri aha laisensi yaawe.
Do not ride for hire if your licence doe: Otatwara bantu ahabwa sente laisensi yaawe yaaba etarikwikiriza ekika ekyo.
Ask the licensing office or a legal aid: Buuza ofiisi erikuha laisensi nari ekitongore ky'obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro waaba otarikuhamya.
Wear a proper helmet, fastened: Jwara enkofiira ehikire, kandi ogikome gye
Regulation 11 of the Traffic and Road Sa: Regulation 11 ya Traffic and Road Safety (Motorcycles and Motorised Tricycles) Regulations, 2016 (S.I. 30 of 2016), nk'oku yahindurirwe S.I. 34 of 2023, neetaka ngu enkofiira zijwarwe kandi zikomwe gye. Okuhindura kwa 2023 nikwongyera ngu enkofiira zihikaane n'ebiragiro bya Uganda National Bureau of Standards.
The helmet must be on your head and prop: Enkofiira eine kuba eri aha mutwe kandi ekomirwe gye, ti kugitwara buti. Eshemereire kuhikaana n'omutindo gwa UNBS. Omuntu ou otwaire nawe naayetengyesa enkofiira.
Koma gye enkofiira yaawe otakatandikire buri rugyendo.
Use a helmet that meets the UNBS standar: Kozesa enkofiira ehikaine n'omutindo gwa UNBS.
Shaba omuntu ou otwaire nawe ajware enkofiira.
Traffic convictions can be recorded agai: Emisango y'omu muhanda neebaasa kuhandiikwa aha laisensi yaawe
Section 122A, inserted by the Traffic an: Section 122A, eyayongyerwemu Traffic and Road Safety Act (Amendment) Act 2020, neeha Minisita obushoboorozi bw'okukora ebiragiro aha nteekateeka y'obubonero bw'emisango (demerit points). Ebiragiro ebyo nibiteeka emisango omu bika okurugiirira aha bukuru bwagyo, kandi obubonero buhandiikwe aha laisensi y'omuntu ogwo.
If you are convicted of some traffic off: Waaba bakusingire emisango emwe y'omu muhanda, obubonero nibubaasa kuhandiikwa aha laisensi yaawe. Ebaruha yoona ehandiikirwe giteho omutima, kandi shaba obuhabuzi otakaikirize musango.
Ask for a written notice stating the exa: Shaba ebaruha ehandiikirwe erikworeka omusango gwennyini n'ekiragiro ekirikugambwaho.
Keep the notice and any official receipt: Biika gye ebaruha na risiiti yoona ya gavumenti.
Ask a legal aid provider what the notice: Buuza ekitongore ky'obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro eki ebaruha erikumanyisa otakasasuire nari kwikiriza omusango.
The current Ugandan law on public and pr: Ekiragiro kya Uganda ekiriho hati aha butare bwa gavumenti n'obw'abantu, okuhandiikisa abacuruzi, okugaba ebifo, omushoro n'empaka.
Amends the Traffic and Road Safety Act:: Neehindura Traffic and Road Safety Act: ebihandiiko bya laisensi, obubonero bw'emisango (demerit points), emisango n'ebihano.
Amends the 2016 motorcycle regulations,: Neehindura ebiragiro bya pikipiki ebya 2016, harimu ebiragiro by'enkofiira n'eby'abarikutwara abantu.
KCCA rules for certain named street trad: Ebiragiro bya KCCA aha mirimo emwe y'okucururiza omu mihanda omu Kampala.
Applies only to specific street trader a: Nibikora aha mirimo emwe y'abacuruzi b'omu mihanda omu Kampala yonka — ti aha buri kifo ky'omu katare.
The Markets Act, 2023 sets out how publi: Markets Act, 2023 neeyoreka oku obutare bwa gavumenti burikushemerera kutegyekwa. Ebi nibyo ebirikukwata munonga aha bacuruzi.
Section 18(4) of the Markets Act, 2023 p: Section 18(4) ya Markets Act, 2023 negamba ngu omucuruzi ahandiikwa ahabw'obusha. Section 18(5) neetaka enamba y'okuhandiikwa, kandi section 18(8) neetaka ngu orukarara rw'abacuruzi rworekwe.
You should not be charged just to be reg: Toshemereire kusasurizibwa ahabw'okuhandiikwa kwonka. Oshemereire kuhabwa enamba y'okuhandiikwa, kandi orukarara rw'abacuruzi rworekwe kubaasa kureeba eiziina ryawe.
Check that your name appears on the disp: Reeba ngu eiziina ryawe riri aha rukarara orworekirwe.
Keep your registration slip or card safe: Biika gye orupapura nari kaadi yaawe y'okuhandiikwa.
Section 21 of the Markets Act, 2023 prov: Section 21 ya Markets Act, 2023 neeteekaho akakiiko k'okugaba ebifo by'okukoreramu, amaduuka n'emidaala omu butare bwa gavumenti. Abacuruzi abahandiikirwe kare nibo babanza. Omucuruzi tarikwikirizibwa kuba n'ekifo ekirenga kimwe, kandi okupangisa ekifo otaine bushoboorozi tikurikwikirizibwa; orikupangisa atikiriziibwe aine kukirugamu.
A committee, not just one official, deci: Akakiiko, ti omukozi omwe wenka, nikko karikucwamu oha orikuhabwa ekifo. Waaba wahandiikirwe kare omu katare ako, niiwe oshemereire kubanza kuhabwa. Nobaasa kuba n'ekifo kimwe kwonka kandi tobaasa kukipangisa otaine bushoboorozi.
Keep your allocation slip and registrati: Biika orupapura rw'okuhabwa ekifo n'ebihandiiko by'okuhandiikwa.
Ask who sits on the allocation committee: Buuza abari omu kakiiko k'okugaba ebifo.
Section 16(2) of the Markets Act, 2023 r: Section 16(2) ya Markets Act, 2023 neetaka ebaruha ehandiikirwe y'emyezi eshatu nibura batakahindwire entebekanisa nari enyombeka y'akatare ka gavumenti.
If the market will be reorganised or reb: Akatare kaaba nikeija kutegyekwa bundi nari kwombekwa bundi, abacuruzi baine kumanyisibwa omu buhandiike nibura emyezi eshatu kare. Okubagambira omu kanwa kwonka tikimara.
Raise your objections through the market: Gamba ebi otarikwikiriza omu kakiiko k'akatare emirimo etakatandikire.
Market fees must be set and displayed: Omushoro gw'akatare gushemereire kuteekwaho kandi gworekwe
Section 24(1) and (2) of the Markets Act: Section 24(1) na (2) ya Markets Act, 2023 negamba ngu omushoro gw'akatare guteekwaho ab'obuyobozi kandi gushemereire kworekwa.
You should be able to see the official f: Oshemereire kubaasa kureeba orukarara rw'omushoro rwa gavumenti. Bakushaba kusasura sente ezitari aha rukarara, shaba okushoboororwa omu buhandiike na risiiti.
Section 22 of the Markets Act, 2023 trea: Section 22 ya Markets Act, 2023 netwara ekifo nk'ekyarekirwe kyaba kimazire emyezi eshatu kitarimu muntu nari omucuruzi yaaba atasasuire omushoro gw'akatare emyezi eshatu. Section 26(2) kuhika (5) negamba ngu ebintu nibibaasa kukwatwa kandi biguzibwe hanyuma y'ebiro 14, sente ezirikusigara zigarurwe, kandi ekifo kihabwe ondiijo.
If your stall is empty for three months,: Ekifo kyawe kyaba kimazire emyezi eshatu kitarimu muntu, nari waaba otasasuire omushoro emyezi eshatu, ab'obuyobozi nibabaasa kukitwara nk'ekyarekirwe. Ebintu byaba byakwatirwe, ekiragiro nikiteekaho omuringo: kuguzibwa hanyuma y'ebiro 14, kandi sente zoona ezirikusigara hanyuma y'okusasura ebyakozesiibwe ni zaawe.
Keep paying fees or agree a written paym: Komeza kusasura omushoro nari muhikaane aha nteekateeka y'okusasura ehandiikirwe.
If you will be away, tell market managem: Waaba nooza kuburaho, manyisa abakuru b'akatare omu buhandiike.
If goods are seized, ask for a written i: Ebintu byaba byakwatirwe, shaba orukarara rwabyo oruhandiikirwe n'eki kirikwija kukorwa sente ezirikusigara.
Section 19(3) and 19(5)(c) of the Market: Section 19(3) na 19(5)(c) ya Markets Act, 2023 neeteekaho abakuru b'ebitongore by'akatare abaatoorainwe kandi neebaha emirimo, harimu okucwamu empaka.
If you disagree with market management o: Waaba otarikwikiraniza n'abakuru b'akatare nari omucuruzi ondiijo, Act neetaka ngu abakuru b'ebitongore abaatoorainwe babanze kucwamu empaka egyo.
Ask which department head handles your d: Buuza omukuru w'ekitongore orikucwamu empaka yaawe.
Put your complaint in writing and keep a: Handiika enshonga yaawe kandi obiike kopi.
If it is not resolved, contact a legal a: Yaaba etaacwiremu, kwatanisa n'ekitongore ky'obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro.
Section 32 of the Markets Act, 2023 proh: Section 32 ya Markets Act, 2023 netanga okucuruza aheeru y'ekifo ekyateekirweho n'omu mihanda y'abantu nari emyoboro y'amaizi.
Trade from the space allocated to you. D: Curuuriza omu kifo eki wahairwe. Okuteeka ebintu omu mihanda y'abantu nari okuziba emyoboro y'amaizi nibibaasa kureetera kuhanwa.
Reeba ahu ekifo eki wahairwe kiri.
Otateeka bintu omu mihanda y'abantu nari omu myoboro y'amaizi.
Ask market management to confirm your sp: Shaba abakuru b'akatare bahamye ekifo kyawe omu buhandiike.
The current Ugandan law on vendor regist: Ekiragiro kya Uganda ekiriho hati aha kuhandiikisa abacuruzi, okugaba ebifo, omushoro, ebaruha n'empaka.
Relevant if a dispute involves a vehicle: Nikikwataho empaka yaaba erimu ekimotoka nari okutwara ebintu kuza nari kuruga omu katare.
